examples.text_en: He can play the bassoon very well.
examples.text_zh: 他巴松管吹得很好。

examples.text_en: The bassoon makes a low and deep sound.
examples.text_zh: 巴松管发出低沉的声音。

examples.text_en: Please baste the two pieces before the last step.
examples.text_zh: 请在最后一步之前把这两片粗缝起来。

examples.text_en: She will baste them together and then she will stop.
examples.text_zh: 她会把它们粗缝在一起，然后就停下来。

examples.text_en: He made a large batch of food for the group.
examples.text_zh: 他为这群人做了一大批食物。

examples.text_en: The next batch will be ready in a few days.
examples.text_zh: 下一批几天后就准备好了。

examples.text_en: The bather stood still in the deep water.
examples.text_zh: 那位入浴者一动不动地站在深水里。

examples.text_en: The bather went back to the house for a rest.
examples.text_zh: 那个游泳者回到屋里休息。

examples.text_en: His words were bathetic and far too old.
examples.text_zh: 他的话陈腐，而且太老套。

examples.text_en: The whole story felt bathetic to the young man.
examples.text_zh: 整个故事在年轻人看来很陈腐。

examples.text_en: He put on a blue bathrobe.
examples.text_zh: 他穿上了一件蓝色的浴衣。

examples.text_en: Her old bathrobe was on the back of the door.
examples.text_zh: 她的旧浴衣挂在门后。

examples.text_en: The man used the baton to lead the music.
examples.text_zh: 那个人用指挥棒引领音乐。

examples.text_en: She held the baton and ran to the next girl.
examples.text_zh: 她握着接力棒跑向那个女孩。

examples.text_en: A whole battalion was sent to the south.
examples.text_zh: 整整一个营被派往南方。

examples.text_en: The battalion moved along the long road at night.
examples.text_zh: 部队在夜里沿着大路前进。

examples.text_en: That field became a battleground in the war.
examples.text_zh: 那片田野在战争中成了战场。

examples.text_en: The old battleground is a park today.
examples.text_zh: 如今这片旧战场是一座公园。

examples.text_en: She bought a small bauble for her child.
examples.text_zh: 她给孩子买了一个小玩意。

examples.text_en: The bauble looks nice but it is worth nothing.
examples.text_zh: 这个小玩意儿好看，却一文不值。

examples.text_en: The men found bauxite under the hard ground.
examples.text_zh: 人们在这坚硬的地面下发现了铝土矿。

examples.text_en: They use bauxite to make many good things.
examples.text_zh: 他们用铝土矿制造许多好东西。

examples.text_en: His bawdy words made the whole room feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他猥亵的话语让整个房间的人都感到不快。

examples.text_en: The man told a bawdy story to his friends.
examples.text_zh: 那人给朋友们讲了个猥亵的故事。

examples.text_en: We went to the old bazaar to buy food.
examples.text_zh: 我们去那个老集市买食物。

examples.text_en: The bazaar is full of people every morning.
examples.text_zh: 这个集市每天早上都挤满了人。

examples.text_en: The old beacon can still show the way home.
examples.text_zh: 那座老灯塔仍能指引回家的路。

examples.text_en: We saw a beacon across the dark sea at night.
examples.text_zh: 我们在夜里看见黑暗的海上有一座灯塔。

examples.text_en: The child held a small bead in her hand.
examples.text_zh: 孩子手里握着一颗小珠子。

examples.text_en: A bead of water ran down her face.
examples.text_zh: 一滴水顺着她的脸流下来。

examples.text_en: The beaded work on the wall looks very nice.
examples.text_zh: 墙上那件珠饰作品看起来非常漂亮。

examples.text_en: A beaded light was over the old table.
examples.text_zh: 一盏珠状灯挂在旧桌子上方。

examples.text_en: That dark beak looks very long and hard.
examples.text_zh: 那个深色的鸟嘴看起来又长又硬。

examples.text_en: The long beak can be a very hard thing.
examples.text_zh: 长鸟嘴可以是非常坚硬的东西。

examples.text_en: She put the beancurd into the hot water.
examples.text_zh: 她把豆腐放进热水里。

examples.text_en: Beancurd is a good food for the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 豆腐是适合全家人的好食物。

examples.text_en: She had a beatific look on her face.
examples.text_zh: 她脸上带着极乐的表情。

examples.text_en: A beatific look came over his old face.
examples.text_zh: 他苍老的脸上露出极乐的神情。

examples.text_en: She put the bedclothes on the bed at night.
examples.text_zh: 她夜里把铺盖铺在床上。

examples.text_en: Please bring the bedclothes back before the day ends.
examples.text_zh: 请在一天结束前把铺盖拿回来。

examples.text_en: The beddings are kept in this room.
examples.text_zh: 寝具都收在这个房间里。

examples.text_en: She wants new beddings for the small room.
examples.text_zh: 她想给这个小房间换新寝具。

examples.text_en: They will bedeck the room with white and gold.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用白色和金色装饰这个房间。

examples.text_en: She used old art to bedeck the whole wall.
examples.text_zh: 她用旧艺术品装点整面墙。

examples.text_en: She would bedizen her hair with gold and red.
examples.text_zh: 她会用金色和红色把自己的头发打扮得俗丽。

examples.text_en: They bedizen the old stage with too much gold.
examples.text_zh: 他们用过多的金色把旧舞台装点得俗丽。

examples.text_en: The whole room was bedlam after the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 坏消息传来后，整个房间乱成一团。

examples.text_en: It was bedlam in the street that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天夜里街上喧闹不堪。

examples.text_en: The dog came home and looked bedraggled.
examples.text_zh: 那狗回到家，看上去浑身泥污。

examples.text_en: Her bedraggled hair was over her face.
examples.text_zh: 她湿透的头发盖在脸上。

examples.text_en: The men found bedrock under the old field.
examples.text_zh: 人们在旧田地下面发现了基岩。

examples.text_en: Good trust is the bedrock of a strong family.
examples.text_zh: 信任是牢固家庭的根基。

examples.text_en: He lives in a small bedsit near the school.
examples.text_zh: 他住在学校附近一间小卧室兼起居室里。

examples.text_en: The bedsit is small but it is a home.
examples.text_zh: 这间卧室兼起居室很小，却是个家。

examples.text_en: A beehive was on the back wall.
examples.text_zh: 一个蜂箱挂在后墙上。

examples.text_en: The beehive is full of life in summer.
examples.text_zh: 夏天蜂箱里充满生机。

examples.text_en: The long question will befuddle the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 这个冗长的问题会把小男孩弄糊涂。

examples.text_en: Too much news can befuddle the best of us.
examples.text_zh: 过多的消息会把我们中最聪明的人也弄糊涂。

examples.text_en: He looked at me in complete befuddlement.
examples.text_zh: 他一脸迷惑地看着我。

examples.text_en: Her befuddlement was clear to the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 她的迷惘在这群人面前一目了然。

examples.text_en: He tried to beguile the girl with kind words.
examples.text_zh: 他试图用好话诱骗那个女孩。

examples.text_en: They will beguile you if you are too kind.
examples.text_zh: 如果你太善良，他们就会诱骗你。

examples.text_en: He is beholden to the man who helped him.
examples.text_zh: 他感激那个帮助过他的人。

examples.text_en: We are beholden to them for their great help.
examples.text_zh: 我们感谢他们的大力帮助。

examples.text_en: It would behoove you to think before you act.
examples.text_zh: 你最好三思而后行。

examples.text_en: It will behoove us to plan the work today.
examples.text_zh: 我们今天理应把工作安排好。

examples.text_en: The man would belabor the poor boy again.
examples.text_zh: 那人又会痛打那个可怜的男孩。

examples.text_en: He did not mean to belabor the small dog.
examples.text_zh: 他并不是想痛打那只小狗。

examples.text_en: We sent a belated note to our old friend.
examples.text_zh: 我们给老朋友寄了一封迟来的信。

examples.text_en: His belated help came after the work was done.
examples.text_zh: 他迟来的帮助在活儿干完之后才到。

examples.text_en: He had to belch in front of his friends.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不在朋友们面前打嗝。

examples.text_en: Do not belch at the table, young man.
examples.text_zh: 年轻人，别在饭桌上打嗝。

examples.text_en: The army will beleaguer the old town.
examples.text_zh: 军队将围攻这座老城。

examples.text_en: Many problems beleaguer the small group.
examples.text_zh: 许多问题困扰着这个小团体。

examples.text_en: His kind face seemed to belie a hard heart.
examples.text_zh: 他和善的脸似乎掩盖着一颗冷酷的心。

examples.text_en: Her words belie the hate in her heart.
examples.text_zh: 她的话与心中的恨意并不相符。

examples.text_en: Do not belittle the work of the young man.
examples.text_zh: 不要轻视这个年轻人的工作。

examples.text_en: She would belittle him in front of everyone.
examples.text_zh: 她常当着大家的面贬低他。

examples.text_en: The bellicose man was always ready to fight.
examples.text_zh: 那个好战的人总是准备打架。

examples.text_en: His bellicose words made the group stop and think.
examples.text_zh: 他好战的话语让这群人停下来思考。

examples.text_en: His belligerence made the meeting very hard.
examples.text_zh: 他的好战态度让会议很难进行。

examples.text_en: The belligerence of the two men was clear.
examples.text_zh: 这两个人的敌意清楚可见。

examples.text_en: He gave a belligerent answer and left the room.
examples.text_zh: 他给了一个好斗的回答，然后离开了房间。

examples.text_en: The belligerent group was ready for a long fight.
examples.text_zh: 这个好战的团体准备好打一场持久战。

examples.text_en: The old man used bellows to make the fire hot.
examples.text_zh: 老人用风箱把火吹旺。

examples.text_en: Bellows are a big help for a small fire.
examples.text_zh: 风箱对小堆火来说很有用。

examples.text_en: That company is a bellwether for the whole market.
examples.text_zh: 那家公司是整个市场的领头羊。

examples.text_en: The bellwether of the group was an old man.
examples.text_zh: 这群人的领头者是一位老人。

examples.text_en: He was bemused by the long and hard question.
examples.text_zh: 那个又长又难的问题让他困惑不解。

examples.text_en: She looked bemused at the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 她一脸发呆地看着这群人。

examples.text_en: The old man gave us a kind benediction.
examples.text_zh: 老人给了我们一个慈祥的祝福。

examples.text_en: Her words were a benediction to the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 她的话是对整群人的赐福。

examples.text_en: The school had a great benefactor for many years.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校多年来有一位了不起的捐助者。

examples.text_en: He was a benefactor to the poor of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他是城里穷人的恩人。

examples.text_en: She was the main beneficiary of the old will.
examples.text_zh: 她是那份旧遗嘱的主要受益人。

examples.text_en: The young man is a beneficiary of this good plan.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人是这项好计划的受惠者。

examples.text_en: The benevolent old man gave food to all.
examples.text_zh: 那位慈善的老人把食物分给大家。

examples.text_en: Her benevolent words made the child feel safe.
examples.text_zh: 她善意的话语让孩子感到安全。

examples.text_en: They said the change was benign and small.
examples.text_zh: 他们说这个变化是良性的，而且很小。

examples.text_en: He had a benign look and a kind voice.
examples.text_zh: 他神色善良，声音和蔼。

examples.text_en: The old man gave them his benison.
examples.text_zh: 老人给了他们祝福。

examples.text_en: A benison was said over the new home.
examples.text_zh: 人们为新家念了祝福。

examples.text_en: She left a small bequest to the old school.
examples.text_zh: 她给那所老学校留下了一笔小小的遗赠。

examples.text_en: The bequest will help many poor children.
examples.text_zh: 这笔遗产将帮助许多穷孩子。

examples.text_en: The man would berate his son for every small thing.
examples.text_zh: 那人会为每件小事严厉责骂儿子。

examples.text_en: She did not want to berate the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 她不想严厉责备那个小男孩。

examples.text_en: He felt bereft after his old friend left.
examples.text_zh: 老朋友走后，他感到若有所失。

examples.text_en: The poor child was bereft of all hope.
examples.text_zh: 这个可怜的孩子失去了一切希望。

examples.text_en: He went berserk and broke the whole door.
examples.text_zh: 他发疯了，把整扇门都弄坏了。

examples.text_en: The man went berserk when he lost the game.
examples.text_zh: 那人输掉比赛时发了狂。

examples.text_en: This berth is mine for the whole night.
examples.text_zh: 这个铺位整个晚上都归我。

examples.text_en: He put his things in the berth and slept.
examples.text_zh: 他把东西放进铺位里就睡了。

examples.text_en: He would beseech the king for his help.
examples.text_zh: 他会向国王恳求帮助。

examples.text_en: She did beseech them to stay one more day.
examples.text_zh: 她确实恳求他们再多留一天。

examples.text_en: Many problems beset the small town that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年，许多问题困扰着这个小镇。

examples.text_en: The old man was beset by bad news.
examples.text_zh: 老人被坏消息困扰着。

examples.text_en: Her kind words bespeak a good heart.
examples.text_zh: 她亲切的话语显示出善良的心。

examples.text_en: The old house bespeaks a long and deep history.
examples.text_zh: 这座老房子显示出悠久的历史。

examples.text_en: The bestial act made the whole town stop.
examples.text_zh: 这残忍的行为让整个镇子都停了下来。

examples.text_en: He had a bestial look on his dark face.
examples.text_zh: 他深色的脸上带着野兽般的表情。

examples.text_en: The king will bestow his trust on the young man.
examples.text_zh: 国王会把信任授予这个年轻人。

examples.text_en: They will bestow food and water on the poor.
examples.text_zh: 他们将为穷人施予食物和水。

examples.text_en: Dark news can betoken a long and hard year.
examples.text_zh: 阴暗的消息可能预示着艰难的一年。

examples.text_en: Those words betoken a change in the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 这些话预示着整个计划的变化。

examples.text_en: He will betroth himself to her this year.
examples.text_zh: 他今年会和她订婚。

examples.text_en: They will betroth the young man and woman.
examples.text_zh: 他们会为这个年轻男子和女子定下婚事。

examples.text_en: The many new words will bewilder the boy.
examples.text_zh: 这么多新词会让男孩不知所措。

examples.text_en: Long talks about the plan bewilder most people.
examples.text_zh: 关于这个计划的长篇讨论让大多数人困惑。

examples.text_en: The whole place was a bewildering sea of faces.
examples.text_zh: 整个地方是一片令人眼花缭乱的人海。

examples.text_en: It was a bewildering time for the young man.
examples.text_zh: 对那个年轻人来说，那是一段令人困惑的日子。

examples.text_en: The old bibliophile has a room full of books.
examples.text_zh: 这位老藏书家的房间里堆满了书。

examples.text_en: A true bibliophile can never walk past a book.
examples.text_zh: 真正的爱书者绝不会对一本书视而不见。

examples.text_en: The bibulous man used all his money in one night.
examples.text_zh: 那个嗜酒的人一夜之间用光了所有的钱。

examples.text_en: His bibulous ways were the talk of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他嗜酒的作风成了全镇的谈资。

examples.text_en: The country has a bicameral system of law.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家实行两院制的法律体系。

examples.text_en: They want a bicameral form of government.
examples.text_zh: 他们想要两院制的政府形式。

examples.text_en: The two children bicker about the same old thing.
examples.text_zh: 两个孩子为同一件旧事斗嘴。

examples.text_en: They bicker all day but they are good friends.
examples.text_zh: 他们整天斗嘴，却是好朋友。

examples.text_en: The old man did the bidding of the king.
examples.text_zh: 老人遵照国王的吩咐行事。

examples.text_en: The bidding for the old house went very high.
examples.text_zh: 那栋老房子的出价涨得很高。

examples.text_en: The group has a biennial meeting every two years.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体每两年开一次会。

examples.text_en: It is a biennial event for the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 这是全镇两年一次的活动。

examples.text_en: The old road will bifurcate near the small town.
examples.text_zh: 这条老路将在小镇附近分叉。

examples.text_en: The long line can bifurcate into two parts.
examples.text_zh: 这条长线可以分为两叉。

examples.text_en: The bigot would not listen to any new idea.
examples.text_zh: 那个偏执的人听不进任何新想法。

examples.text_en: A bigot often thinks his own way is best.
examples.text_zh: 盲从的人常认为自己的方式最好。

examples.text_en: His bigoted words made the meeting end early.
examples.text_zh: 他固执己见的话让会议早早结束。

examples.text_en: The bigoted man had no friends at all.
examples.text_zh: 那个偏执的男人一个朋友也没有。

examples.text_en: Bigotry can make good people do bad things.
examples.text_zh: 偏执会让好人做出坏事。

examples.text_en: The town was full of bigotry and old hate.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇充满了偏见和旧恨。

examples.text_en: The two countries had a bilateral talk last week.
examples.text_zh: 两国上周进行了双边会谈。

examples.text_en: They want a bilateral deal for the new trade.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望就新的贸易达成双边协议。

examples.text_en: His words were full of bile and old hate.
examples.text_zh: 他的话里满是怒气和旧恨。

examples.text_en: The bad news brought out the bile in him.
examples.text_zh: 坏消息激起了他心中的怒气。

examples.text_en: The bilious man had a bad word for all.
examples.text_zh: 那个脾气坏的人对谁都没有好话。

examples.text_en: He gave me a bilious look and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他恶狠狠地看了我一眼，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: The man tried to bilk the old woman.
examples.text_zh: 那人企图欺骗那位老太太。

examples.text_en: They will bilk you if you are too kind.
examples.text_zh: 如果你太善良，他们就会赖你的账。

examples.text_en: A big billow came up out of the sea.
examples.text_zh: 一个巨浪从海里涌起。

examples.text_en: The billow was as high as the old house.
examples.text_zh: 那巨浪高得和那栋老房子一样。

examples.text_en: The billowy sea was too much for us.
examples.text_zh: 汹涌的大海让我们吃不消。

examples.text_en: The whole sea looked dark and billowy.
examples.text_zh: 整片海看上去又黑又汹涌。

examples.text_en: They will bind the box with a long line.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用长绳把箱子绑起来。

examples.text_en: A good word can bind two friends together.
examples.text_zh: 一句好话能把两个朋友连在一起。

examples.text_en: They played bingo in the old school room.
examples.text_zh: 他们在老学校的房间里玩宾戈。

examples.text_en: Bingo is a game that many old people love.
examples.text_zh: 宾戈是许多老人喜爱的一种游戏。

examples.text_en: She will study biochemistry at the new school.
examples.text_zh: 她将在新学校学习生物化学。

examples.text_en: Biochemistry is a hard but beautiful science.
examples.text_zh: 生物化学是一门艰难却美丽的科学。

examples.text_en: The biographer gave ten years to that book.
examples.text_zh: 这位传记作者把十年光阴给了那本书。

examples.text_en: She wants to be a biographer one day.
examples.text_zh: 她希望有一天成为传记作者。

examples.text_en: He read a long biography of a great king.
examples.text_zh: 他读了一部关于一位伟大国王的长篇传记。

examples.text_en: Her biography of the old man was a great success.
examples.text_zh: 她为那位老人写的传记大获成功。

examples.text_en: They did a biological study of the small sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们对这片小海域做了生物学研究。

examples.text_en: The biological side of life is hard to see.
examples.text_zh: 生命的生物学一面很难看见。

examples.text_en: The biosphere is the home of all life.
examples.text_zh: 生物圈是一切生命的家园。

examples.text_en: We must keep the biosphere safe for our children.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须为孩子们保护好生物圈。

examples.text_en: This biotech company is doing very well.
examples.text_zh: 这家生物技术公司经营得很好。

examples.text_en: He works in biotech and loves his job.
examples.text_zh: 他在生物技术行业工作，热爱自己的职业。

examples.text_en: A man is a biped that can walk and run.
examples.text_zh: 人是能够行走和奔跑的两足动物。

examples.text_en: Most bipeds can stand and walk quite well.
examples.text_zh: 大多数两足动物都能很好地站立和行走。

examples.text_en: The old art shows a bipedal form.
examples.text_zh: 那件古艺术品展示了一个两足的形象。

examples.text_en: A bipedal walk is not easy for a small child.
examples.text_zh: 对小孩子来说，两足行走并不容易。

examples.text_en: The old birdcage was on the back wall.
examples.text_zh: 那个旧鸟笼挂在后墙上。

examples.text_en: She put some food and water in the birdcage.
examples.text_zh: 她在鸟笼里放了些食物和水。

examples.text_en: That small town is the birthplace of the king.
examples.text_zh: 那个小镇是这位国王的诞生地。

examples.text_en: He went back to his birthplace after many years.
examples.text_zh: 多年之后他回到了自己的诞生地。

examples.text_en: The bishop gave a talk at the old church.
examples.text_zh: 主教在老教堂做了一次讲话。

examples.text_en: A kind bishop was loved by all the people.
examples.text_zh: 一位仁慈的主教深受所有人爱戴。

examples.text_en: A bison is big and strong and very fast.
examples.text_zh: 野牛又大又壮，而且跑得很快。

examples.text_en: The bison can run over the long field.
examples.text_zh: 野牛能在长长的田野上奔跑。

examples.text_en: They put bitumen on the road to make it hard.
examples.text_zh: 他们把沥青铺在路上，使它变硬。

examples.text_en: Bitumen is a dark and very hard thing.
examples.text_zh: 沥青是一种又黑又硬的东西。

examples.text_en: The old group will blackball the new man.
examples.text_zh: 这个老团体将投反对票拒绝这个新人。

examples.text_en: They gave him the blackball and he had to leave.
examples.text_zh: 他们投了他的反对票，他只好离开。

examples.text_en: He tried to use blackmail to get the money.
examples.text_zh: 他试图用勒索来弄到那笔钱。

examples.text_en: Blackmail is a bad way to make a living.
examples.text_zh: 勒索是一种糟糕的谋生方式。

examples.text_en: Her face did blanch at the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 听到坏消息，她的脸变白了。

examples.text_en: They will blanch the food in hot water first.
examples.text_zh: 他们会先把食物放进热水里焯白。

examples.text_en: His blandishment did not move the old man.
examples.text_zh: 他的甜言蜜语没有打动那位老人。

examples.text_en: She saw through the blandishment and said no.
examples.text_zh: 她看穿了那些奉承话，拒绝了。
